need: 25 blanks of 6061-T6 aluminum, at least 4.88 x 3.31 x 1.10 in (e.g. 1.125 in thick x 3.50 in wide flat bar, cut to 5.00 in lengths)

quotes.item: 6061-T6 flat bar 1 x 3-1/2 in, saw-cut to 5 in
quotes.pricing_basis: $21.40 per foot of bar (10.5 ft for 25 pcs incl. kerf/roundup) + $3.00 per cut; about $11.99/piece before tax and delivery
quotes.delivery: Flat $35 on their truck to Oakland (East Bay), ships next business day; or same-day will-call pickup in San Leandro if ordered before 2 PM
substitutions: Offered 1 in thick instead of the requested 1-1/8 in. This is under the 1.11 in minimum blank thickness, so it does not work for the part.
open_questions: The quoted 1 x 3-1/2 bar is too thin (1.00 in vs the 1.11 in minimum). The buyer rejected it, so this quote can't be used as written.

The supplier contradicted itself. It first listed 1-1/4 x 3-1/2 at $26.80/ft, 1-1/4 x 4 at $30.50/ft and 1-1/2 x 3-1/2 at $32.xx/ft (cut off). Then it said it stocks nothing 1.11 in thick or thicker in this line. Need to confirm whether 1-1/4 or 1-1/2 thick 6061-T6 bar is actually available, and get a firm price.
The transcript ends mid-sentence before the supplier gives any alternative for the 1.11 x 3.31 x 4.89 blank.
Arithmetic checks out: 10.5 ft x $21.40 = $224.70; 25 cuts x $3 = $75; subtotal $299.70; plus $35 delivery = $334.70.
Quote held for 7 days. Mill cert availability was not confirmed.

quotes.item: 6061-T6 aluminum precision saw-cut blanks from plate, 1.125 x 3.50 x 5.00 in
quotes.delivery: Free delivery to Oakland, CA (order over $250); ETA 2 business days from order release. Mill certs included at no charge.
substitutions: Cut from 6061-T6 plate instead of flat bar. Bay Alloy doesn't stock 1-1/8 x 3-1/2 flat bar, and the size is still the 1.125 x 3.50 x 5.00 in that was requested
quotes.pricing_basis: per lb: $6.20/lb, about 1.93 lb per piece (about $11.98/piece as stated)
open_questions: Arithmetic mismatch: 25 x 1.93 lb = 48.25 lb, not the stated 48.35 lb. $6.20 x 1.93 = $11.97/pc, not $11.98. 25 x $11.98 = $299.50. 48.25 lb x $6.20 = $299.15. 48.35 lb x $6.20 = $299.77. None of these equal the stated total of $299.40, which we kept. All figures were given as 'about', so ask for a firm price on the emailed formal quote.
Quote number was first said as BAS40312, then repeated as 'BAS4031'. Buyer read back BAS40312 and the supplier confirmed it. Check this on the written quote.
Saw-cut tolerance was stated as 'plus zero, zero six', which is unclear. Confirm whether it is +/-0.06 in (about 1/16) or +0.06/-0.
Ask for the formal quote by email, including how long the quote is valid.
